name: c-scheduler-internal-development-workloads
description: Internal CPU-bound workloads for validating the C-module FIFO and optimized scheduling flow. These are not customer acceptance cases.

workloads.name: case-1-two-long-two-short
workloads.description: Two long tasks are deliberately placed on the same FIFO core by round-robin ordering.

workloads.name: case-2-three-level-load
workloads.description: Three long or medium tasks alternate with short tasks to create an unbalanced FIFO mapping.

workloads.name: case-3-descending-heavy-load
workloads.description: Heavy tasks are placed at every other position so the static FIFO baseline concentrates them on one core.
